s1.syndrome_frame: Pruritic papular eruption of the extremities with a chronic time course
salient_findings: Rapidly spreading intensively pruritic papules on the extremities
Erythematous, annular papules measuring up to 5 mm wide
Asymptomatic brown flat papules on the face
key_facts: Female patient in her 50s
3-month history of symptoms
No remarkable medical or family history
No concurrent medications
Previous treatment with topical steroid ointments and oral compound glycyrrhizin tablets had no effect
Papules are scattered and erythematous
Palms, soles, and oral mucosa are not involved
Laboratory tests showed no abnormal findings
Skin biopsy revealed mild hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, and atrophy of the epidermis
Histopathology showed well-developed cornoid lamellae and individual cell dyskeratosis
Slight infiltrate of lymphocytes, histiocytes, and eosinophils in the upper dermis

shortlist.label: Grover disease
shortlist.why_kept: Matches pruritic papular eruption with histopathological findings of cornoid lamellae and dyskeratosis

shortlist.label: Darier disease
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by keratotic papules and histopathological findings of dyskeratosis and suprabasal acantholytic dyskeratosis

shortlist.label: Keratosis pilaris
shortlist.why_kept: Presents with keratotic papules on extremities, although typically less pruritic

shortlist.label: Pityriasis rubra pilaris
shortlist.why_kept: Can present with pruritic keratotic papules, but often involves palms and soles

shortlist.label: Lichen planus
shortlist.why_kept: Can cause pruritic papular eruption, but histopathology typically shows basal cell degeneration and civatte bodies

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Can present with pruritic papules, but typically associated with muscle weakness and distinct histopathological features

shortlist.label: Papular urticaria
shortlist.why_kept: Presents with pruritic papules, but typically due to insect bites or other external stimuli

shortlist.label: Phrynoderma
shortlist.why_kept: Presents with keratotic papules, but often associated with nutritional deficiencies or other systemic conditions
